reads_as: a cutaway Earth cracked open to a molten glowing core floating in space
layout_map: Dead-center hero: a sliced-open Earth model fills the lower-middle (cells 10-11-15, centered ~x160,y105 in this ~320px-wide Short frame), its top hemisphere peeled away to reveal a glowing orange/yellow molten core sphere hovering just above it at cell 11 (~x160,y75) with small fountain-spray lines arcing up; the half-globe shows a thin blue ocean rim and tan crust band beneath the orange interior. Background is a dark deep-space starfield, blue at edges. No headline text rows; only a tiny faint caption strip across the globe's midline (~y130). Whole composition is a single object lit by its own internal glow against black.
why_it_works: the planet sliced open exposes a forbidden glowing interior, triggering the 'what's inside' curiosity with a single self-lit object and no text clutter
mimic_for: a hidden interior or internal-architecture reveal — cracking a system open to show its glowing core
title: What’s Really Inside The Earth?

reads_as: the tiny Moon way up top, a glowing arrow measuring the huge gap down to Earth
layout_map: Two objects stacked vertically on a black starfield: a small grey Moon at top-center in cell 3 (~x160,y35) and a larger blue-marble Earth at center in cell 11 (~x160,y115, filling ~lower third). Connecting them down the vertical centerline is a bright green/cyan glowing measuring arrow with a small caption label mid-shaft (~x160,y80, cell 7), the arrowhead pointing down toward Earth — it visualizes the distance/scale gap. Tiny caption strip across Earth's midline (~y150). Background dark space with faint stars; the whole frame is an empty vertical gap deliberately separating the two bodies to read the distance.
why_it_works: the exaggerated empty vertical gap plus the measuring arrow makes a scale fact feel shocking — 'it's REALLY that far' lands instantly
mimic_for: a surprising scale or distance stat — two things farther apart (or bigger) than you'd expect, measured with an arrow
title: How Far Away The Moon REALLY Is

reads_as: host cradling a tiny fluffy puppy against her chest, soft delighted reaction
layout_map: Host occupies the full vertical frame, face upper-center in cells 2-3 (~x150,y45) looking down with a soft smile/raised-brow reaction, wearing a blue top. Her two hands cradle a small fluffy blue-merle puppy held against her chest at center-low, cells 11-15 (~x165,y125), the animal filling roughly the middle quarter of frame. A green leafy houseplant sits behind upper-right (cells 4/8). Background is a softly-lit indoor room, slightly blurred. Tiny caption strip low across cell 14/15 (~y150). No big headline rows — the held object + the down-gazing face carry it.
why_it_works: a warm human reaction directed at a held creature creates parasocial pull; the small subject cradled in hands implies a size/shrink payoff without text
mimic_for: a personal reaction to something small or precious — host presenting a tiny object with affection or awe
title: What If We Made A Shrink Ray?

reads_as: a glowing red baby squid drifting in deep blue-black water, alien and small
layout_map: A single translucent red-orange juvenile squid floats dead-center, cell 11 (~x160,y90), body and tentacles fanning right across cells 7-8, lit against an almost-black deep-water background tinted dark blue. Faint dark coral/rock shapes blur in at the left edge (cells 1/5) and upper right (cell 4). The creature's red glow is the only saturated color in an otherwise desaturated abyss. Small italic caption strip dead-center-low (~x160,y148, cell 15) reading like a label. No headline rows; full-bleed underwater object framing.
why_it_works: one vivid red specimen isolated in a vast dark void reads as a rare/alien discovery — scarcity and strangeness stop the scroll
mimic_for: a rare specimen or single discovered object presented in isolation against darkness
title: They Found the Colossal Squid by Accident

reads_as: the words DARK ENERGY in glowing caps over a black void split by a faint cyan glow
layout_map: Two-row centered headline as the hero: 'DARK' on row one and 'ENERGY' on row two, bold condensed white caps stacked dead-center in cells 6-7 (baseline of row two ~y95, ~x160), with the 'R' or accent letters tinted cyan and a subtle glow halo. The text sits over a near-black background with a faint vertical cyan light-beam splitting the frame up the centerline (the 'dark energy' motif). Faint ghosted duplicate of the same text bleeds at the very top edge (cell 1-4, ~y15). A small caption strip below the headline center-low (~x160,y148, cell 15). No face, no object — typography on void is the whole composition.
why_it_works: a bold mysterious term glowing in a black void with a question-implying split treats the topic itself as the hook; minimal and high-contrast
mimic_for: naming an abstract or mysterious concept as the headline — the term itself is the intrigue, set as glowing type on black
title: Dark Energy Is Getting Weaker?

reads_as: a glowing yellow-rimmed chamber growing a diamond, labeled 5 DAYS
layout_map: Centered hero: a bright yellow/amber glowing square chamber frames a small embedded diamond/crystal sample dead-center, cell 11 (~x160,y95), the neon box outline acting like a viewport into a growth machine. Above it a pill/banner label reads '5 DAYS' in yellow caps at center, cell 3 (~x160,y45), the stat tell. Background is a warm-tinted machined interior (copper/teal industrial walls) flanking the glowing box left (cells 5/9) and right (cells 8/12). A small caption strip runs below the box center-low (~x160,y150, cell 15). The glowing framed object plus the time-stat banner carry it.
why_it_works: a glowing machine viewport plus a surprising time number ('5 DAYS') promises a fast man-made version of something rare — process-reveal curiosity
mimic_for: a fast or surprising process result — a machine/method producing something precious in a shocking timeframe, with the number as the tell
title: This Machine Grows Diamonds
